description: Ready briefing for one horse race from our results: field size, distance, going, class, the favourite, each runner's form figures and last run, jockey and trainer strike rates over the last 30 days; after the race the winner, starting price and whether the favourite won. Each statement also as a sentence (lang de, es, it, fr). Facts only.

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)
